Sakizuke (先付け), An appetizer that sets the tone for the meal, featuring seasonal ingredients
Owan (お椀 ), A warm soup dish
Aemono (和え物), A mixed dish, typically with seasonal vegetables
Yakimono (焼き物), A grilled dish, often featuring fish or meat
Takiawase (炊き合わせ), A course with separately simmered vegetables served alongside other ingredients
Oshokuji (お食事), A rice course, typically accompanied by miso soup and a selection of side dishes
Dessert (デザート), The final course, featuring seasonal fruits or delicate sweets for a light and refreshing finish
